chunks: And so are among men, beasts and cattle, different shades. Only those of His creatures fear God who have knowledge. Verily He is all-mighty and forgiving.
ai.seo_question: Who are the people that truly fear God according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes a causal link between deep knowledge (ilm) and God-fearing consciousness (khushu), distinguishing the 'ulama as those who perceive the divine signs in creation's diversity. It underscores that true piety is not merely ritualistic but rooted in intellectual and spiritual insight, a concept central to the Shia emphasis on the authority of the learned. The concluding attributes of 'Aliz (Mighty) and Ghafur (Forgiving) reassure that this profound knowledge leads to divine mercy rather than intimidation.
